Hollowstrike

A first-person hero shooter across a dozen hostile worlds. Hold off the waves, topple the bosses, or battle your friends.

Layout Hills, platforms, cover and hazards are randomly placed
Random arena every runEach run and each match picks a different arena for you
New layout every runTurn off to keep this layout until you press New layout
Left thumb moves (push all the way to sprint). Drag the right side to look. Hold Fire to shoot.

Key bindings

Click a binding, then press any key or mouse button. Esc cancels. If the key is already used, the two actions swap.

Paused

Versus

Pick a fight

Free-for-All, teams, Gun Game and more, against AI bots. To fight other people, choose Versus in Split-screen or Online.

Online

Play online

Team up or face off across devices. One device hosts and the others join. Everyone needs this game open in Claude and signed in: the same account on two devices works, or invite a friend to the game from the Share menu.

Local multiplayer

Split-screen

Up to four players on one screen: hold the line together, race, or fight each other in Versus. Join with a PS4 controller or the keyboard. If a teammate goes down, stand next to them to revive them.
